categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou UIGreen Micro&Nano Technologies Co., Ltd. focuses on micro-precision manufacturing technologies, specializing in MEMS microelectronic components, semiconductor chip testing probes, and micro-drive systems. The company serves international chip and semiconductor packaging and testing manufacturers, MEMS device manufacturers, and smart home appliance sectors, providing products like MEMS shielding covers, semiconductor test probes, and precision transmission components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced micro-precision manufacturing techniques including multi-row mold design, high-speed processing, micro-bimetal shielding technology, micro-resistance welding, complex deep drawing, and micro-precision semiconductor chip test probe manufacturing. It has developed high-frequency, high-current test probes and sockets capable of meeting demanding specifications such as 40GHz frequency and 5A current load, with automated assembly for fine pitch probes down to 0.4mm spacing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global semiconductor chip manufacturers, semiconductor packaging and testing firms, and MEMS device producers. Major end markets served are communication electronics, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, industrial IoT, AI-driven applications, and smart home devices. The company has established strong relationships with clients like NVIDIA, GoerTek, and Resideo.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, and has expanded its global footprint with subsidiaries and marketing networks in the United States, Japan, Switzerland, Singapore, and the Philippines. Overseas sales have grown substantially, reflecting a strategic global market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: UIGreen operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of semiconductor chip testing probes and MEMS components. It supplies critical consumables and precision components used in semiconductor wafer testing and packaging processes, as well as micro-drive systems for smart devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on upgrading existing products and developing new high-performance semiconductor test probes, MEMS components, and micro-drive systems. It emphasizes collaboration with academic and research institutions, patent portfolio expansion, and global R&D infrastructure to support product innovation and market expansion, particularly targeting AI, 5G, and IoT applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of micro-precision manufactured products including MEMS components, semiconductor chip testing probes, and micro-drive systems. The company employs a direct sales model with some VMI consignment arrangements, and revenue is recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: UIGreen is positioned as a strong competitor domestically within the semiconductor chip testing probe and MEMS microcomponent sectors, recognized as a leading supplier to international chip and semiconductor packaging companies. It benefits from advanced manufacturing capabilities and a growing global customer base, competing against both domestic and international precision component manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 569 million, nearly doubling from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders reduced to RMB 8.7 million. The company has shown significant revenue growth driven by market expansion and product diversification, while continuing to invest about 10% of revenue in R&D. Total assets reached approximately RMB 1.4 billion, with steady growth in both domestic and international sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: UIGreen emphasizes its core competency in micro-precision manufacturing technology, delivering high-quality, high-precision MEMS and semiconductor test probes with superior performance metrics such as high-frequency capability, low insertion loss, and long service life. The company differentiates itself through advanced automated production, strong R&D capabilities, customized solutions for diverse applications, and a robust global supply and service network ensuring rapid response and high customer satisfaction.
